title: QrgChannelConfig
description: Schema for frequency channels and sonde types in qrg.txt and web interface

type.description: Human-readable sonde type string (e.g. RS41, DFM, RS92, M10/M20, MP3H)

typech.description: Single-character sonde type identifier: 4=RS41, N=RS41 Narrow, R=RS92, D=DFM, M=M10/M20, 3=MP3H
